title: FlowDoc Fast Delivery Risk Register Checklist

items.label: Capture the Work path, owner repository, role, phase, checklist, evidence target, risks, and unknown state.
items.evidenceTarget: The risk register record identifies Project Control ownership before writing fast-delivery risk framing.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-fast-delivery-risk-register, owner repo-project-control, active role planning-partner with documentation-authority-steward and evidence-registrar responsibilities, phase target phase-flowdoc-fast-delivery-risk-register, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-fast-delivery-risk-register, and evidence target evidence-flowdoc-fast-delivery-risk-register-2026-09-04.

items.label: Write a failing Project Control guard before adding the fast-delivery risk records.
items.evidenceTarget: A focused records test fails before Project Control contains the fast-delivery risk Work, document, checklist, and evidence records.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-fast-delivery-risk-register.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed because flowdoc-product-development-resumption did not yet include flowdoc-fast-delivery-risk-register as a child Work.

items.label: Record terminology and database drift risks around Structure Pattern terms and legacy component_* names.
items.evidenceTarget: The risk register records RISK-FD-001 and RISK-FD-002.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-fast-delivery-risk-register-2026-09-04.md records terminology risk and database drift risk.

items.label: Record UX scope and truth promotion risks before faster Editor, Backend, or Core lanes.
items.evidenceTarget: The risk register records RISK-FD-003 and RISK-FD-004.
items.verificationNote: The register states that Build and Preview must remain separate and that planning docs must not be treated as product implementation evidence.

items.label: Record speed and dependency risks for Lean Dispatch and worktree dependency warnings.
items.evidenceTarget: The risk register records RISK-FD-005 and RISK-FD-006.
items.verificationNote: The register preserves automatic return, liveness, retrievable locator, acceptanceGate, and dependency warning boundaries.

items.label: Define a compact Kickoff Packet risk gate for fast future lanes.
items.evidenceTarget: The risk register includes a fast Kickoff risk gate for future PLAN rooms.
items.verificationNote: The fast Kickoff risk gate lists terminology, legacy component_*, Build/Preview split, planning truth, automatic return, liveness, retrievable locator, acceptanceGate, and dependency checks.

items.label: Verify Project Control records, generated read model, and checks.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused records guard, generated read model, Project Control data validation, and full Project Control checks pass.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence target: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-fast-delivery-risk-register.test.ts --maxWorkers=1, npm run generate, npm run check:data, and npm run check.
